The table 'table1_incremental_results' details the performance metrics (R² and MSE) for various machine learning models (SVM, DT, RF, KNN, XGBoost) as the number of features increases from 1 to 11, using the feature subset 'Sucrose_Degradation -> VFA -> COD-O -> Butyrate -> VSS -> pH -> Acetate -> Ethanol -> Propionate -> ORP_Mid -> ORP_Low'.

Across all feature subsets (n_features 1 through 11):

- SVM consistently achieves an R² score of 0.0, with MSE values ranging from 0.00999937964675071 (1 feature) to 0.006607876482459992 (10 features).
- XGBoost consistently achieves an R² score of 0.0, with MSE values remaining very small (e.g., 7.477596651503524e-14).

In summary, the performance of DT, RF, and KNN remains perfect (R²=1.0, MSE=0.0) regardless of the feature set size, while SVM and XGBoost maintain an R² of 0.0 across all tested feature subsets.
